title: Webhook signature verification
description: Each scenario verifies one shared vector from spec/conformance/vectors/webhooks.json offline: no target or network is involved. Drivers expose their SDK's verifier through the webhooks.verify feature; see spec/conformance/webhook-signatures.md.

scenarios.title: Signed with the only configured secret
Any one of several space-separated signatures may match
A timestamp exactly toleranceSeconds old is accepted
During rotation a delivery signed with the new secret verifies
During rotation a delivery signed with the previous secret still verifies
A signature made with a different secret is rejected with WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID
A body that differs from the signed body is rejected with WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID
A correctly signed delivery older than the tolerance is rejected with WEBHOOK_TIMESTAMP_EXPIRED
A correctly signed delivery too far in the future is rejected with WEBHOOK_TIMESTAMP_FUTURE
Several configured secrets, none of which signed the delivery with WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID
A delivery without webhook-signature is rejected with WEBHOOK_HEADERS_MISSING
A non-integer webhook-timestamp is rejected even when signed with WEBHOOK_TIMESTAMP_INVALID
Signatures with an unknown version prefix are ignored with WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID
